status: post-outcome scale diagnostic frozen after fine-scale collective-versus-personal results and before opening this scale-transfer outcome
role: tests where along the horizontal spatial hierarchy self-history begins to outperform conspecific history

source_result.interpretation: not independent confirmation; a mechanism localization analysis

history.fixed_target_support: exact target fixes lying in 500-m cells with both focal-self and other-individual vertical-history support, matching Lane B

estimator.session_horizontal_probability: P(cell) from all fixes in that historical session at the stated scale
estimator.self_model: equal-session mean horizontal probability from focal-individual past
estimator.other_model: equal-individual mean of each other individual's equal-session horizontal probability
estimator.target_score: mean over the same fixed target fixes of log P_self(cell) - log P_other(cell)
estimator.aggregation: equal target session within biological individual, then equal biological individual

primary_contrasts.coarse_self_advantage: mean horizontal self-minus-other gain at 10 km
primary_contrasts.fine_self_advantage: mean horizontal self-minus-other gain at 500 m

classification.coarse_portable_fine_personal: 10-km interval includes 0 or mean <= 0, 500-m lower bound > 0, and scale-amplification lower bound > 0

claim_boundary: A near-zero coarse self advantage means conspecific history is approximately as predictive as self history at that scale; it is not proof of social learning or colony memory.
A positive scale amplification localizes increasing individualization toward finer horizontal geometry.
The already-known 500-m conditional vertical personal increment is interpreted separately as an additional within-cell 3D layer.
No scale, lag, support set, weighting, bootstrap rule or classification may change after outcome opening.
